main_topics.reason: The user opened with an A1C rise from 6.8 to 7.4 and wanted to understand why, driving most of the conversation.
The user described six months of broken sleep and loud snoring and returned to it as probably a big piece.
The user asked what an individualized target means after a doctor only said under 7.
The user wanted a plan so as not to get the same shrug and summarized an agenda for the appointment.
The user said they have no meter and asked whether to get one, then asked why morning versus after-meal readings matter.
The user mentioned gaining 5-6 pounds and asked whether it matters for blood sugar, in a short exchange.
The user said they were worried the diabetes was suddenly getting worse and that they expected to hear it is downhill because of age.
The user asked at the start whether the rise is just an age thing.

output.summary: A 61-year-old user whose A1C rose from 6.8 to 7.4 with no routine changes wanted to understand why. The bot walked through possible contributors, picked up on poor sleep and snoring as a possible sleep apnea sign, and helped the user build a clear agenda for the doctor. The user said it was much more useful than expected and felt better.
